A short daily practice beats a long weekly one. Twenty minutes split between technique, chord changes, a song and some ear training covers most of what a beginner guitarist needs. Warm up with slow finger exercises, then drill the one change that is hardest this week, then play a whole song even with mistakes. Recording yourself shows timing problems you cannot hear while playing. Keep a log of tempos so progress on [[Barre chords]] and [[Strumming patterns]] is visible.
